title: Swift client cannot find the generated module
root_cause: The workflow emits ShelfIndex into artifacts/modules but searches artifacts/module when typechecking the client. The compiler's missing-module error follows from that incorrect search path.

relevant_evidence.why: The module output and search directory differ.
The compiler reports that it cannot find the module.
The module is written to the plural directory and searched for in the singular one.
The module source is present in the repository.
